verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Mastra lets developers author their own MCP servers that expose agents and tools. That is a developer building block for constructing MCP servers, not an official first-party Mastra MCP server that an agent can connect to. No documented official Mastra MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint appears in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Mastra supports authoring Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, exposing agents, tools and other structured resources via the MCP interface.
